products.title: Drop Shot Sakura 3.0 2021 - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021 - Created for those players with fewer hours on the court, but who above all want a durable and quality racket. A model that is renewed for another season thanks to its success. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

We present to you one of the classic rackets already in the Drop Shot padel racket collections. This is the new DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021, a model that is committed to bringing quality to low-cost rackets, including technologies and materials common in higher-priced rackets.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021 has been created with beginner players or players with few hours on the court in mind who are looking for a quality padel racket to progress as much as possible.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The feature section of this DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021 leaves us with surprising elements, rarely seen in blades of this price.

On this occasion Drop Shot has used a diamond mold in this racket, something unusual in beginner rackets but which is understood in order to increase its sweet spot. In the frames we find the TWIN TUBULAR SYSTEM, from Drop Shot, a common feature that we see in their highest-end rackets (such as the conqueror), and which reinforces the structure of the racket to give us firmer hits while increasing the durability of the racket.

Drop Shot Fiber Glass appears on the faces, giving our shots more quality, elasticity and ball output, as well as a soft touch, also helped by the Eva Soft rubber.

BLADE DESIGN

The design section of the DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021 uses basic, less strident colors to give elegance and simplicity to the racket.

PLAY STYLE

If we focus on the style of play, the DROP SHOT SAKURA 3.0 2021 stands out for its large sweet spot, playing styles that seek better control in each shot to continue progressing will benefit.

 Another of the Drop Shot rackets that you may like is this DROP SHOT SAKURA 2.0 2020
